1.text: Arababwira ati “Ndababwira ukuri yuko aba ngaba bahagaze hano, harimo bamwe bazabona ubwami bw'Imana buzanye ububasha batarapfa.”

2.text: Nuko iminsi itandatu ishize, Yesu ajyana Petero na Yakobo na Yohana bonyine abageza mu mpinga y'umusozi muremure, umubiri we uhindukira imbere yabo.

3.text: Imyenda ye irarabagirana yera de de, kandi nta mumeshi wo mu isi wese wabasha kuyeza atyo.

4.text: Maze Eliya na Mose barababonekera bavugana na Yesu.

5.text: Petero abwira Yesu ati “Mwigisha, ni byiza ubwo turi hano. Reka duce ingando eshatu, imwe yawe, indi ya Mose n'indi ya Eliya.”

6.text: Ntiyari azi icyo akwiriye kuvuga, kuko bari batinye rwose.

7.text: Maze igicu kiraza kirabakingiriza, ijwi rikivugiramo riti “Nguyu Umwana wanjye nkunda mumwumvire.”

8.text: Bakebaguza vuba, ariko ntibagira undi babona keretse Yesu gusa uri kumwe na bo.

9.text: Bakimanuka umusozi arabihanangiriza ngo batagira uwo babwira ibyo babonye, keretse Umwana w'umuntu amaze kuzuka.

10.text: Bazigama iryo jambo bagenda babazanya bati “Mbese kuzuka ni iki?”

11.text: Baramubaza bati “Ni iki gituma abanditsi bavuga bati ‘Eliya akwiriye kubanza kuza’?”

12.text: Arabasubiza ati “Ni koko, Eliya ni we ukwiriye kubanza kuza ngo atunganye byose, akababazwa cyane kandi agashinyagurirwa nk'uko byanditswe ku Mwana w'umuntu na we.

13.text: Ariko ndababwira yuko Eliya yamaze kuza, kandi bamugize uko bashaka nk'uko byanditswe kuri we.”

14.text: Bageze aho abigishwa be bari babona iteraniro ry'abantu ribakikije, n'abanditsi bajya impaka na bo.

15.text: Uwo mwanya abantu bamubonye baratangara cyane, barirukanka baramusanganira, baramuramutsa.

17.text: Umwe muri bo aramusubiza ati “Mwigisha, nkuzaniye umwana wanjye utewe na dayimoni utavuga,

18.text: aho amusanze hose iyo amufashe amutura hasi, akamubirisha ifuro, akamuhekenyesha amenyo, akamugagaza. Mbwira abigishwa bawe ngo bamwirukane, ntibabishobora.”

19.text: Arabasubiza ati “Yemwe bantu b'iki gihe batizera, nzageza he kubana namwe? Nzabihanganira kugeza ryari? Nimumunzanire.”

20.text: Baramumuzanira.Dayimoni abonye Yesu, atigisa uwo mwana cyane, aragwa arigaragura, abira ifuro.

21.text: Yesu abaza se ati “Yafashwe ryari?”Aramusubiza ati “Yafashwe akiri umwana.

22.text: Kenshi cyane amuta mu muriro cyangwa mu mazi ngo amwice. Ariko niba ubishobora, tugirire imbabazi udutabare.”

23.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Uvuze ngo ‘Niba mbishobora’? Byose bishobokera uwizeye.”

24.text: Uwo mwanya se w'uwo mwana avuga cyane ati “Ndizeye, nkiza kutizera.”

25.text: Yesu abonye iryo teraniro ry'abantu rimushikiye biruka acyaha dayimoni ati “Yewe dayimoni utavuga kandi utumva, ndagutegetse muvemo, ntukamugarukemo ukundi.”

26.text: Arataka aramutigisa cyane, amuvamo asiga umuhungu asa n'upfuye, bituma benshi bavuga bati “Arapfuye.”

28.text: Yinjiye mu nzu abigishwa be babonye ko biherereye baramubaza bati “Ni iki gitumye twebwe tutashoboye kumwirukana?”

29.text: Arabasubiza ati “Bene uwo ntavanwamo n'ikindi, keretse gusenga no kwiyiriza ubusa.”

30.text: Bavayo banyura i Galilaya, ariko ntiyashaka ko hagira ubimenya,

31.text: kuko yigishaga abigishwa be yuko Umwana w'umuntu azagambanirwa, agafatwa n'abantu bakamwica, ariko hashira iminsi itatu bamwishe, akazuka.

32.text: Ariko ntibamenya iryo jambo, ndetse batinya kumubaza.

33.text: Bagera i Kaperinawumu, yinjiye mu nzu arababaza ati “Icyo mwahoze mugira impaka tukiri mu nzira ni iki?”

34.text: Baramwihorera, kuko mu nzira bahoze bajya impaka z'umukuru wabo uwo ari we.

35.text: Aricara ahamagara abo cumi na babiri arababwira ati “Umuntu ushaka kuba uw'imbere nabe inyuma ya bose, ndetse abe n'umugaragu wa bose.”

36.text: Azana umwana muto amuhagarika hagati yabo, aramukikira arababwira ati

37.text: “Uwemera umwe mu bana bato nk'uyu mu izina ryanjye ni jye aba yemeye, kandi unyemera si jye yemera gusa, ahubwo aba yemeye n'uwantumye.”

38.text: Nuko Yohana aramubwira ati “Mwigisha, twabonye umuntu wirukana abadayimoni mu izina ryawe, turamubuza kuko adasanzwe adukurikira.”

39.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Ntimumubuze, kuko umuntu ukora igitangaza mu izina ryanjye atābasha kunsebya bitamuruhije,

40.text: kuko utari umwanzi wacu aba ari mu ruhande rwacu.

41.text: Umuntu uzabaha agacuma kamwe k'amazi kuko muri aba Kristo, ndababwira ukuri yuko atazabura ingororano ye.”

42.text: “Umuntu wese uzashuka umwe muri aba bato banyizera akamugusha, ibyiza ni uko yahambirwa urusyo mu ijosi akarohwa mu nyanja.

43.text: Ukuboko kwawe nikugucumuza uguce. Ibyiza ni uko wakwinjira mu bugingo usigaranye ukuboko kumwe, biruta ko wajya muri Gehinomu y'umuriro utazima ufite amaboko yombi, [

44.text: aho ‘urunyo rwabo rudapfa kandi n'umuriro ntuzime.’]

45.text: N'ikirenge cyawe, nikigucumuza, ugice: ibyiza ni uko wakwinjira mu bugingo usigaranye ikirenge kimwe, biruta ko wajugunywa muri Gehinomu ufite ibirenge byombi, [

46.text: aho ‘urunyo rwabo rudapfa, kandi n'umuriro ntuzime.’]

47.text: N'ijisho ryawe nirigucumuza urinogore. Ibyiza ni uko wakwinjira mu bwami bw'Imana usigaranye ijisho rimwe, biruta ko wajugunywa muri Gehinomu ufite amaso yombi,

48.text: aho ‘urunyo rwabo rudapfa kandi n'umuriro ntuzime.’

49.text: “Kandi umuntu wese azasābwa n'umuriro, nk'uko umunyu usāba ibyokurya.

50.text: “Umunyu ni mwiza, ariko umunyu iyo ukayutse mwawuryohesha iki? Mwebwe mugire umunyu mu mitima yanyu, kandi mubane amahoro.”
